name: Edgefield
source:
So, here’s the setup: You’re 18 years old and on your way to Edgefield University, an expensive, prestigious school you’re honestly kinda shocked you got into. You’re interested in photography, but are undecided on what you’re going to study. On your ride there, you’re accompanied by your dad, his new girlfriend, Sasha and her daughter, Emma.

Once you arrive, you move into your dorm room and meet your new floormates. Whether you choose to play as a male or female protagonist, you’ll have the freedom to pursue relationships with characters of any gender, with a goal of making this a deeply personal and inclusive experience.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3629970/Edgefield/]Steam[/url]]
